beats.headline: Cirrus Logic gains 3.8% on heavy volume
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic shares climbed 3.75% to close at $148.69 on twice its 30-day average volume. No company-specific news accompanied the rally, though the advance was company-specific as customer Apple added just 0.11% and competitor Qualcomm gained 0.15%, while supplier TSMC dropped 6.22%.

beats.headline: Shares jump 4.5% on new chip line and PT boost
beats.explanation: The stock climbed 4.52% to $164.84 after Cirrus Logic launched a new family of industrial imaging integrated circuits for scanning systems. Analyst Tore Svanberg at Stifel also raised his price target on the stock from $163 to $175 while keeping a Buy rating. The move diverged from connected peers, as customer Apple fell 1.14% and supplier TSMC declined 3.13%.

beats.headline: Stock drops 4.8% amid semiconductor demand worries
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic fell 4.85% to $162.51 as broader semiconductor equities pulled back following reports that OpenAI missed internal sales and user targets. The retreat was shared with supplier TSMC, which dropped 3.12%, though customer Apple gained 1.16%.

beats.headline: Shares slip another 3.2% without fresh catalysts
beats.explanation: The stock retreated 3.21% to $157.29 on average volume, extending the previous session's decline. No new company-specific announcements were reported, and the move was company-specific as competitor Qualcomm rallied 4.00% and supplier TSMC rose 0.38%.

beats.headline: Stock drops 4.9% alongside competitor weakness
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic shares fell 4.86% to $146.50 without direct corporate news. Weakness was shared with semiconductor competitor Qualcomm, which dropped 7.57%, even as key customer Apple rose 3.14%.

beats.headline: Stock declines 6.2% as KeyBanc lowers price target
beats.explanation: Shares fell 6.25% to $137.36 after KeyBanc analyst John Vinh trimmed his price target from $200 to $190 while maintaining an Overweight rating. Cirrus Logic also confirmed its fiscal Q1 2027 earnings release date for August 5. Competitor Qualcomm similarly slipped 3.20%, while customer Apple dipped 0.77%.

beats.headline: Stock falls 4.3% in broad peer selloff
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic dropped 4.27% to close at $133.53 despite announcing an R&D grant from Scottish Enterprise for smart energy technology. The decline was shared across connected companies, as competitor Qualcomm fell 2.57%, supplier TSMC fell 1.34%, and customer Apple shed 1.30%.

beats.headline: Shares slide 4.6% as analyst targets drop after Q1
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic tumbled 4.57% to $123.51 on double typical trading volume following its Q1 2027 earnings release. Although revenue of $460 million and EPS of $1.84 set records, results highlighted pricing pressure and PC delays, prompting KeyBanc, Stifel, and Barclays to cut price targets to $170, $160, and $130, respectively. The drop was company-specific, as peers rallied, including competitor Qualcomm up 1.82% and customer Apple up 0.45%.

beats.headline: Stock rebounds 3.7% off cycle lows
beats.explanation: Shares rose 3.66% to $113.06 on 1.45 times average volume, bouncing after an extended summer drawdown. No positive operational headlines emerged, but competitor Qualcomm also gained 2.01%, while customer Apple was virtually unchanged at down 0.05%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic rises 5.2% alongside Apple rally
beats.explanation: The stock gained 5.20% to reach $116.48 on above-average trading volume. The surge coincided with strength from top customer Apple, which advanced 3.56% on the same day, while competitor Qualcomm added 0.27%.

beats.headline: Stock gains 5.0% alongside peer Qualcomm
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic shares surged 5.05% to $122.21 on 1.6 times regular volume as commentary highlighted valuation support and an active share buyback following a 27% three-month drawdown. The rise was shared with competitor Qualcomm, which gained 4.25%, even as customer Apple slipped 0.52%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic pulls back 3.4% following sharp rally
beats.explanation: Shares gave back 3.44% to settle at $118.00 after the previous day's sharp 5% climb. Macro pressures including rising 10-year Treasury yields weighed on broader equities, and peer competitor Qualcomm also declined 1.58%, while customer Apple rose 0.32%.

arc: Cirrus Logic experienced a pronounced boom-and-bust cycle between March and September 2026. The stock initially peaked above $164 in mid-April supported by product expansions in industrial imaging and target increases from Wall Street analysts. However, sentiment deteriorated sharply over the summer as broader semiconductor demand anxieties were compounded by Cirrus Logic's Q1 fiscal 2027 update. Despite reporting record top-line revenue of $460 million, disclosures of PC market pushouts and component pricing pressure prompted widespread analyst target cuts and sent shares tumbling toward $109 by early September. A partial recovery took hold in mid-September as value screens and ongoing share buybacks drew dip-buyers back into the stock.
